name: Northcourt CoolWeave Visor
description: The Northcourt CoolWeave Visor is a lightweight sun visor for hot outdoor sessions. A wet-to-activate cooling sweatband drops the temperature against the forehead for up to two hours, and the UPF 50+ brim shades the eyes on high lobs without blocking overhead vision.
care_instructions: Hand wash in cold water and air dry. Rinse the sweatband after each session so salt does not reduce the cooling effect.
